// The build constraint above is the helper's own file-level language version.
// This file is generated by mvdan.cc/sh/v3 and uses that module's language
// features, but it is compiled inside whatever module the original program
// lives in; without the constraint it would inherit that module's go
// directive -- go1.16 semantics when the go.mod carries none at all. The
// version named here is above every feature the generator emits (generics,
// any, range-over-int, range-over-func) and below the minimum toolchain that
// can build mvdan.cc/sh/v3, so it can neither be withheld nor exclude the file.

// within places a pointer inside the storage of an enclosing array: the
// origin and type of that array, then the index and field steps that select
// the pointee (bashpp_s374_element_address.go).

 Type string `json:"type"`

}

 Field string `json:"field,omitempty"`

}

type sliceBuffer struct {Index int `json:"index"`;Length int `json:"length"`;Value value `json:"value"`}

type response struct { SliceUpdates []sliceBuffer `json:"slice_updates,omitempty"`; Transferred []sliceBuffer `json:"transferred,omitempty"`; PtrUpdates []value `json:"ptr_updates,omitempty"`; Panic *value `json:"panic,omitempty"`; PanicAddr *uint64 `json:"panic_addr,omitempty"`; ID uint64 `json:"id"`; Op string `json:"op,omitempty"`; Selector string `json:"selector,omitempty"`; Receiver *value `json:"receiver,omitempty"`; Values []value `json:"values,omitempty"`; Error string `json:"error,omitempty"`; Parent uint64 `json:"parent,omitempty"`; OutputBarrierStdout uint64 `json:"output_barrier_stdout,omitempty"`; OutputBarrierStderr uint64 `json:"output_barrier_stderr,omitempty"` }

var symbols = map[string]reflect.Value{
//SYMBOLS

// A compiled assembly companion may declare a local frame and no map for it:
// `TEXT ·f(SB),NOSPLIT,$8` with no NO_LOCAL_POINTERS. Nothing asks that frame
// for a map natively, because the only thing such a frame calls is a leaf that
// neither grows a stack nor reaches a collector safe point. What it calls here
// is a trampoline into the interpreter, and that is both. A stack move
// (adjustframe) and a stack scan (scanstack) each read the map the frame does
// not carry, and the runtime answers either with `missing stackmap`, so while
// such a frame is live this process must do neither. companionUnmappedFrames
// names them; it is empty unless a built companion declares one, and then all
// of this is inert.
var companionUnmappedFrames = []string{
//UNMAPPEDFRAMES
}
// companionSymbols are the no-body declarations the companion objects satisfy.
// A call to one of these is the only thing that can put a companion frame on a
// goroutine, so it is where the window opens.
var companionSymbols = map[string]bool{
//COMPANIONSYMBOLS
}
// collectionForcing names the imported functions that start a collection
// whatever the pacing says, spelled as this program spells them.
var collectionForcing = map[string]bool{
//FORCESGC
}
// companionGuard holds the window open. The memory limit is lifted first,
// because it is the one heap trigger that does not consult the percentage, and
// then the percentage is turned off, which returns only once an in-progress
// mark has finished.
//
// That is still not enough on its own. A gcStart that read the old pacing has
// already passed its own re-check of the trigger and is on its way to the
// phase transition; nothing the pacing says now will stop it, and it starts
// its mark after SetGCPercent has returned. So one collection is asked for
// outright. runtime.GC waits for that cycle whether it is the one it started
// or the one it found, and it returns with the collector off; from there the
// pacing admits no further trigger, because the heap goal derived from a
// negative percentage is unreachable and the timed trigger declines outright.
// It is also the one moment when a collection is certainly harmless: the depth
// is zero, so no unmapped frame is live on any goroutine.
var companionGuard = struct {
 sync.Mutex
 depth int
 gcPercent int
 memoryLimit int64
}{}
const companionNoMemoryLimit = int64(^uint64(0)>>1)
func companionGuarded(name string) bool {return len(companionUnmappedFrames)>0&&companionSymbols[name]}
func companionEnterUnmapped() {
 companionGuard.Lock();defer companionGuard.Unlock()
 if companionGuard.depth==0 {
  companionGuard.memoryLimit=bppDebug.SetMemoryLimit(companionNoMemoryLimit)
  companionGuard.gcPercent=bppDebug.SetGCPercent(-1)
  bppRuntime.GC()
 }
 companionGuard.depth++
}
func companionExitUnmapped() {
 companionGuard.Lock();defer companionGuard.Unlock()
 companionGuard.depth--
 if companionGuard.depth==0 {
  bppDebug.SetGCPercent(companionGuard.gcPercent)
  bppDebug.SetMemoryLimit(companionGuard.memoryLimit)
 }
}
// companionSeal keeps the window shut for one collection-forcing call, which
// is why it returns holding the lock: checking and then calling would let a
// window open in between. A window that is already open is refused instead of
// waited for, since the interpreted body that window exists for may be the
// very thing that asked, and waiting would be a deadlock.
func companionSeal(name string) string {
 companionGuard.Lock()
 if companionGuard.depth>0 {
  companionGuard.Unlock()
  return fmt.Sprintf("%s cannot force a garbage collection while an assembly companion frame with no stack map is live: %v",name,companionUnmappedFrames)
 }
 return ""
}
func companionUnseal() {companionGuard.Unlock()}
// companionGrowStack moves this goroutine's stack to its final size before any
// unmapped frame exists on it, so that nothing above that frame can ask the
// runtime to move it. A stack only shrinks inside a collection, which the
// window holds off, so the headroom taken here lasts the whole call.
const companionStackDepth = 128
//go:noinline
func companionGrowStack(depth int) byte {
 var pad [8<<10]byte
 pad[0]=byte(depth)
 pad[len(pad)-1]=pad[0]
 if depth>0 {pad[1]=companionGrowStack(depth-1)}
 return pad[0]^pad[1]^pad[len(pad)-1]
}
//go:noinline
func companionSink(byte) {}
// companionOffFrame runs one trampoline body on a goroutine of its own. Its
// caller is a companion frame the runtime may have no map for, and the body is
// callback protocol: it grows a stack and it blocks at a safe point, the two
// things that frame cannot survive. A goroutine started here has no such frame
// under it and may grow freely; the companion's own goroutine adds only this
// frame, a channel and a park, on a stack it was given before the frame
// existed. A build with no unmapped frame runs the body where it stands.
func companionOffFrame(body func()) {
 if len(companionUnmappedFrames)==0 {body();return}
 done:=make(chan any,1)
 go func(){defer func(){done<-recover()}();body()}()
 if failure:=<-done;failure!=nil {panic(failure)}
}

 "complex64":reflect.TypeFor[complex64](),"complex128":reflect.TypeFor[complex128](),

}

type localStructCodec struct { decode func(*decodeState,value)(reflect.Value,error); structural func(reflect.Value,map[uintptr]bool)value }

func localTypeKey(name string) string { expr,err:=parser.ParseExpr(name);if err!=nil{return name};var b bytes.Buffer;if format.Node(&b,token.NewFileSet(),expr)!=nil{return name};return b.String() }
// mirroredMethodSet names the methods a local type mirrors: each one is a
// generated trampoline that only carries its call back to the original body.
// mirroredMethodExpression proves a func value IS one of them (Type.Method(i)
// .Func of that type, by code identity and signature), so calling it can never
// run dependency code that retains or writes through its arguments.
type mirroredMethodSet struct { types []reflect.Type; names map[string]bool }
var mirroredMethodTypes []mirroredMethodSet
func mirroredMethodExpression(fn reflect.Value) bool {
 if !fn.IsValid()||fn.Kind()!=reflect.Func||fn.IsNil(){return false}
 code:=fn.Pointer()
 for _,set:=range mirroredMethodTypes{for _,typ:=range set.types{for i:=0;i<typ.NumMethod();i++{m:=typ.Method(i);if set.names[m.Name]&&m.Func.Type()==fn.Type()&&m.Func.Pointer()==code{return true}}}}
 return false
}

var originalPointers = struct {sync.Mutex; values map[uint64]reflect.Value; ids map[uintptr]uint64; sent map[uint64]string}{values:map[uint64]reflect.Value{},ids:map[uintptr]uint64{},sent:map[uint64]string{}}
// originalArrays holds, per origin of an enclosing array, the one allocation
// its element pointers are placed in. It is placement only: a pointer decoded
// into it fills and writes back its own subobject, and the array is never
// read as a whole, so it is deliberately not an originalPointers entry.
var originalArrays = struct {sync.Mutex; values map[uint64]reflect.Value}{values:map[uint64]reflect.Value{}}
// maxPlacedArray bounds one placement allocation; a larger array keeps the
// per-pointer storage, whose addresses are unrelated.
const maxPlacedArray = 1<<20
// placedPointer answers the address, typed typ, of the subobject w selects
// inside its root array, allocating the root on first use. It answers the
// zero Value when w does not describe a subobject of that exact type; the
// caller then allocates the pointee on its own, as for any other pointer.
func placedPointer(w *within,typ reflect.Type)(result reflect.Value){
 // A promoted field is not one step of a layout walk and is not placed.
 if w==nil||w.Origin==0||len(w.Steps)==0{return}
 rootType:=resolveType(w.Type);if rootType==nil||rootType.Kind()!=reflect.Array||rootType.Size()>maxPlacedArray{return}
 current:=rootType
 var offset uintptr
 for _,step:=range w.Steps{
  if step.Field!=""{if current.Kind()!=reflect.Struct{return};field,ok:=current.FieldByName(step.Field);if !ok||len(field.Index)!=1{return};offset+=field.Offset;current=field.Type;continue}
  if current.Kind()!=reflect.Array||step.Index<0||step.Index>=current.Len(){return}
  current=current.Elem();offset+=uintptr(step.Index)*current.Size()
 }
 if current!=typ.Elem(){return}
 originalArrays.Lock();root:=originalArrays.values[w.Origin];if !root.IsValid()||root.Type().Elem()!=rootType{root=reflect.New(rootType);originalArrays.values[w.Origin]=root};originalArrays.Unlock()
 return reflect.NewAt(current,unsafe.Add(root.UnsafePointer(),offset))
}
// A subobject shares its address with its first element or field, so an
// address alone does not name an origin: the pointer type completes it.
type pointerKey struct {address uintptr; typ reflect.Type}
var typedPointerOrigins = map[pointerKey]uint64{} // protected by originalPointers
// pointerOrigin answers the origin registered for exactly this pointer, and
// otherwise the origin registered at its address: a pointer the dependency
// derived itself — a promoted receiver, &n.base for an original n — is known
// only by the address it shares with the storage that crossed.
func pointerOrigin(v reflect.Value)uint64{
 originalPointers.Lock();defer originalPointers.Unlock()
 if origin:=typedPointerOrigins[pointerKey{v.Pointer(),v.Type()}];origin!=0{return origin}
 return originalPointers.ids[v.Pointer()]
}
var originalSlices = struct {sync.Mutex; values map[uint64]reflect.Value}{values:map[uint64]reflect.Value{}}
// pointerSnapshot renders one origin pointee so the writeback can report only
// what this dependency actually changed. Without it every later call would
// re-send every live pointee and revert original state it never touched.
// Native pointer handles are freshly allocated by structural, even when the
// pointee still holds the same native object. Compare that object's identity,
// not its transport handle, or a nested call writes stale receiver state back.
func pointerSnapshot(v value)string{v=pointerSnapshotValue(v);b,err:=json.Marshal(v);if err!=nil{return ""};return string(b)}
func pointerSnapshotValue(v value)value{
 if v.Kind=="handle" {handles.Lock();native:=handles.values[v.Handle];handles.Unlock();if native.IsValid()&&native.Kind()==reflect.Pointer {v.Handle=0;v.Text=strconv.FormatUint(uint64(native.Pointer()),16)}}
 if v.Fields!=nil {fields:=make(map[string]value,len(v.Fields));for name,field:=range v.Fields{fields[name]=pointerSnapshotValue(field)};v.Fields=fields}
 if v.Elements!=nil {elements:=make([]value,len(v.Elements));for i,element:=range v.Elements{elements[i]=pointerSnapshotValue(element)};v.Elements=elements}
 if v.Entries!=nil {entries:=make([]bppProtocolEntry,len(v.Entries));for i,entry:=range v.Entries{entries[i]=bppProtocolEntry{Key:pointerSnapshotValue(entry.Key),Value:pointerSnapshotValue(entry.Value)}};v.Entries=entries}
 return v
}
// recordPointee remembers what a pointee looked like when the interpreter last
// sent it. structural takes the same lock for its own pointer case, so the
// rendering must happen outside it.
func recordPointee(origin uint64,ptr reflect.Value){snapshot:=pointerSnapshot(structural(ptr.Elem()));originalPointers.Lock();originalPointers.sent[origin]=snapshot;originalPointers.Unlock()}
// livePointers copies the live origin table so each pointee can be rendered
// without holding the lock structural itself needs.
func livePointers(wanted map[uint64]bool)([]uint64,[]reflect.Value){originalPointers.Lock();defer originalPointers.Unlock();var origins []uint64;var ptrs []reflect.Value;for origin:=range wanted{ptr:=originalPointers.values[origin];if ptr.IsValid()&&ptr.Kind()==reflect.Pointer&&!ptr.IsNil(){origins=append(origins,origin);ptrs=append(ptrs,ptr)}};return origins,ptrs}
var retainedPointerOrigins=map[uint64]bool{}
func collectOrigins(v value,out map[uint64]bool){if v.Origin!=0{out[v.Origin]=true};for _,child:=range v.Elements{collectOrigins(child,out)};for _,child:=range v.Fields{collectOrigins(child,out)};for _,entry:=range v.Entries{collectOrigins(entry.Key,out);collectOrigins(entry.Value,out)}}
func pointerWritebackOrigins(q request)map[uint64]bool{current:=map[uint64]bool{};originalPointers.Lock();for origin:=range retainedPointerOrigins{current[origin]=true};originalPointers.Unlock();if q.PointerReadOnly{return current};explicit:=map[uint64]bool{};if q.Receiver!=nil{collectOrigins(*q.Receiver,explicit)};for _,arg:=range q.Args{collectOrigins(arg,explicit)};originalPointers.Lock();for origin:=range explicit{retainedPointerOrigins[origin]=true;current[origin]=true};originalPointers.Unlock();if q.Receiver!=nil&&(q.Receiver.NativeType=="reflect.Value"||q.Receiver.Type=="reflect.Value"){if ctx,ok:=reflectedContext(q.Receiver.Handle);ok&&ctx.origin!=0{current[ctx.origin]=true}else{originalPointers.Lock();for origin:=range originalPointers.values{current[origin]=true};originalPointers.Unlock()}};return current}
// writablePointee is the set of pointee shapes the interpreter rebuilds at the
// pointer's declared type. A shape outside it is never written back silently.
func writablePointee(kind string)bool{switch kind{case "string","bool","int","uint","float","complex","nil","handle","struct","slice","array","map":return true};return false}
type reflectedMethodContext struct { origin uint64; receiver reflect.Value; selector string }
type nativePointerHandleKey struct { typ reflect.Type; address uintptr }
var handles = struct { sync.Mutex; next uint64; values map[uint64]reflect.Value; pointers map[nativePointerHandleKey]uint64; reflected map[uint64]reflectedMethodContext; stop chan struct{} }{values: map[uint64]reflect.Value{},pointers:map[nativePointerHandleKey]uint64{},reflected:map[uint64]reflectedMethodContext{},stop:make(chan struct{})}
func callbackReceiver(v reflect.Value)value{return structural(v)}
func typeID(t reflect.Type) string { if t.Name()!="" && t.PkgPath()!="" {return t.PkgPath()+"."+t.Name()}; return t.String() }
// seenTypes registers every type this helper has handed the interpreter, by
// the identity it was handed under. A value the interpreter sends back names
// its type by that identity — a package path the program never imported
// (hash.Hash behind md5.New), an instantiation — and resolves here whether or
// not the fixed registry spells it.
var seenTypes sync.Map
func registerType(t reflect.Type) { if t!=nil { seenTypes.LoadOrStore(typeID(t),t) } }
func nativeTypeID(t reflect.Type) string {if t.Kind()==reflect.Pointer{return "*"+nativeTypeID(t.Elem())};if t.Name()!=""&&t.PkgPath()!=""{return t.PkgPath()+"."+t.Name()};return t.String()}
// Tokens are keyed by reflect.Type itself, never its potentially ambiguous String.
var nativeTypeTokens=struct{sync.Mutex;next uint64;ids map[reflect.Type]uint64}{ids:map[reflect.Type]uint64{}}
func nativeTypeToken(t reflect.Type)uint64{if t.Kind()==reflect.Interface{return 0};nativeTypeTokens.Lock();defer nativeTypeTokens.Unlock();if id:=nativeTypeTokens.ids[t];id!=0{return id};nativeTypeTokens.next++;nativeTypeTokens.ids[t]=nativeTypeTokens.next;return nativeTypeTokens.next}
var localWriterState=struct{sync.Mutex;revoked map[*bppOS.File]bool}{revoked:map[*bppOS.File]bool{}}
func localWriterName(v reflect.Value)string{
 if v.Type()==reflect.TypeOf(bppIO.Discard){return "discard"}
 if v.Type()!=reflect.TypeFor[*bppOS.File]()||v.IsNil(){return ""};file:=v.Interface().(*bppOS.File);name:="";if file==bppOS.Stdout{name="stdout"}else if file==bppOS.Stderr{name="stderr"};if name==""{return ""}
 localWriterState.Lock();revoked:=localWriterState.revoked[file];localWriterState.Unlock();if revoked{return ""};return name
}
func revokeLocalWriter(v reflect.Value){if v.Type()!=reflect.TypeFor[*bppOS.File]()||v.IsNil(){return};file:=v.Interface().(*bppOS.File);if file!=bppOS.Stdout&&file!=bppOS.Stderr{return};localWriterState.Lock();localWriterState.revoked[file]=true;localWriterState.Unlock()}
func encodeHandle(v reflect.Value,result value)value {
 result.NativeTypeID=nativeTypeToken(v.Type())
 result.LocalWriter=localWriterName(v)
 if v.Kind()==reflect.Pointer&&v.IsNil(){result.Kind="nil";return result}
 if v.Kind()==reflect.Chan&&v.IsNil(){result.NilChannel=true}
 // A pointer the interpreter transported under an origin stays that origin's
 // pointer however deep in the value graph reflect reaches it, so a handle
 // minted for it names the interpreter's own storage. The interpreter owns the
 // methods of a materialised original type, and only the origin lets it find
 // the receiver again (bashpp_s809_original_handles.go).
 if v.Kind()==reflect.Pointer&&result.Origin==0 {
  origin:=pointerOrigin(v)
  if origin!=0{result.Origin=origin;result.Session=bridgeAuth[:16]}
 }
 handles.Lock();defer handles.Unlock()
 var pointerKey nativePointerHandleKey
 if v.Kind()==reflect.Pointer {
  pointerKey=nativePointerHandleKey{v.Type(),v.Pointer()}
  if id:=handles.pointers[pointerKey];id!=0{result.Kind="handle";result.Handle=id;return result}
 }
 handles.next++;id:=handles.next;copy:=reflect.New(v.Type()).Elem();copy.Set(v);handles.values[id]=copy
 // Retaining the pointer value prevents its address being reused while the
 // session's typed-address key remains live. Native ownership stays unchanged.
 if v.Kind()==reflect.Pointer{handles.pointers[pointerKey]=id}
 result.Kind="handle";result.Handle=id
 if v.Type()==reflect.TypeFor[reflect.Value]()&&v.CanInterface(){result.Storage=originalSliceStorage(v.Interface().(reflect.Value))}
 return result
}
func originalSliceStorage(v reflect.Value)uint64 {
 for v.IsValid()&&v.Kind()==reflect.Interface&&!v.IsNil(){v=v.Elem()}
 originalSlices.Lock();defer originalSlices.Unlock()
 for id,slice:=range originalSlices.values {
  if !slice.IsValid()||slice.Kind()!=reflect.Slice||slice.IsNil(){continue}
  if v.IsValid()&&v.Kind()==reflect.Slice&&v.Type()==slice.Type()&&!v.IsNil()&&v.Pointer()==slice.Pointer(){return id}
  if !v.IsValid()||!v.CanAddr()||v.Type()!=slice.Type().Elem()||slice.Cap()==0{continue}
  address:=v.Addr().Pointer();start:=slice.Pointer();size:=slice.Type().Elem().Size()
  if size>0&&address>=start&&address<start+uintptr(slice.Cap())*size{return id}
 }
 return 0
}
func reflectedContext(id uint64)(reflectedMethodContext,bool){handles.Lock();defer handles.Unlock();ctx,ok:=handles.reflected[id];return ctx,ok}
func setReflectedContext(id uint64,ctx reflectedMethodContext){handles.Lock();handles.reflected[id]=ctx;handles.Unlock()}
func encode(v reflect.Value) value {
 if !v.IsValid() { return value{Kind:"nil"} }
 static:="";if v.Kind()==reflect.Interface {registerType(v.Type());static=typeID(v.Type());if v.IsNil(){return value{Kind:"nil",Type:static,Interface:static}};v=v.Elem()}
 registerType(v.Type())
 result:=value{Type:typeID(v.Type()),NativeType:nativeTypeID(v.Type()),Interface:static,Function:v.Kind()==reflect.Func}
 if v.Type().PkgPath()!=""&&v.Type().PkgPath()!="main"&&!token.IsExported(v.Type().Name()){return encodeHandle(v,result)}
 switch v.Kind(){
 case reflect.String: result.Kind="string";result.Text=v.String();result.Bytes=[]byte(v.String())
 case reflect.Bool:result.Kind="bool";result.Text=strconv.FormatBool(v.Bool())
 case reflect.Int,reflect.Int8,reflect.Int16,reflect.Int32,reflect.Int64:result.Kind="int";result.Text=strconv.FormatInt(v.Int(),10)
 case reflect.Uint,reflect.Uint8,reflect.Uint16,reflect.Uint32,reflect.Uint64,reflect.Uintptr:result.Kind="uint";result.Text=strconv.FormatUint(v.Uint(),10)
 case reflect.Complex64,reflect.Complex128:result.Kind="complex";result.Text=strconv.FormatComplex(v.Complex(),'g',-1,v.Type().Bits())
 case reflect.Float32,reflect.Float64:result.Kind="float";result.Text=strconv.FormatFloat(v.Float(),'g',-1,v.Type().Bits())
 default:return encodeHandle(v,result)
 }
 return result
}
// structural encodes a value by shape rather than by handle. A callback
// receiver crosses back into the interpreter, which owns the original method
// body and needs the field names, element values and defined type name. A
// pointer held in an interface keeps the pointer type even though its pointee
// supplies the structural payload; that type is the interface's dynamic type.
// structural walks a value graph; a pointer met again on its own path is a
// cycle and is encoded as a back-reference to its origin (no pointee) — the
// shape the interpreter rebuilds as the original pointer that origin names.
// Scalar and aggregate values without pointers need no cycle tracking. Build
// the path only when the first local pointer is reached; a nil path is safe
// for reads and is shared by the recursive walk after that point.
func structural(v reflect.Value) value { return structuralPath(v,nil) }
func structuralPath(v reflect.Value,path map[uintptr]bool) value {
 if !v.IsValid() { return value{Kind:"nil"} }
 static:="";if v.Kind()==reflect.Interface {registerType(v.Type());static=typeID(v.Type());if v.IsNil(){return value{Kind:"nil",Type:static,Interface:static}};v=v.Elem()}
 registerType(v.Type())
 result:=value{Type:typeID(v.Type()),Interface:static}
 switch v.Kind(){
 case reflect.Pointer:if pkg:=v.Type().Elem().PkgPath();pkg!=""&&pkg!="main"{encoded:=encode(v);encoded.Interface=static;return encoded};if v.IsNil(){return value{Kind:"nil",Type:result.Type,Interface:static}};origin:=pointerOrigin(v);if path[v.Pointer()]{return value{Kind:"pointer",Type:result.Type,Interface:static,Origin:origin,Session:bridgeAuth[:16]}};if path==nil{path=make(map[uintptr]bool)};path[v.Pointer()]=true;inner:=structuralPath(v.Elem(),path);delete(path,v.Pointer());inner.Interface=static;if static!=""{inner.Type=result.Type};inner.Origin=origin;return inner
 case reflect.Struct:if codec,ok:=localStructCodecs[v.Type()];ok{encoded:=codec.structural(v,path);encoded.Interface=static;return encoded};if v.Type().PkgPath()!=""{encoded:=encode(v);encoded.Interface=static;return encoded};result.Kind="struct";result.Fields=map[string]value{};for i:=range v.NumField(){f:=v.Type().Field(i);if !f.IsExported(){continue};result.Fields[f.Name]=structuralPath(v.Field(i),path)};return result
 case reflect.Slice,reflect.Array:if v.Kind()==reflect.Slice&&v.IsNil(){return value{Kind:"nil",Type:result.Type,Interface:static}};result.Kind="slice";if v.Kind()==reflect.Array{result.Kind="array"};for i:=range v.Len(){result.Elements=append(result.Elements,structuralPath(v.Index(i),path))};return result
 case reflect.Map:if v.IsNil(){return value{Kind:"nil",Type:result.Type,Interface:static}};result.Kind="map";for iter:=v.MapRange();iter.Next();{result.Entries=append(result.Entries,bppProtocolEntry{Key:structuralPath(iter.Key(),path),Value:structuralPath(iter.Value(),path)})};return result
 }
 encoded:=encode(v);encoded.Interface=static;return encoded
}
// callback asks the interpreter to run one original method body. The helper
// never compiles an original body; the generated mirror method's entire body
// is this protocol exchange.
var callbacks = struct { sync.Mutex; next uint64; waiting map[uint64]chan request }{waiting: map[uint64]chan request{}}
var outbound = struct { sync.Mutex; encoder *json.Encoder }{}
// Scratch belongs to one active dispatch, including its callbacks and deferred
// writeback. Pool pointers, not slice headers (boxing a header allocates).
// Fixed storage bounds retention; unusually wide calls use an unpooled slice.
const callArgsScratchLimit = 16
type callArgsScratch struct { values [callArgsScratchLimit]reflect.Value }
var callArgsPool sync.Pool
func borrowCallArgs(n int)([]reflect.Value,*callArgsScratch){
 if n==0{return nil,nil}
 if n>callArgsScratchLimit{return make([]reflect.Value,n),nil}
 cached:=callArgsPool.Get()
 var scratch *callArgsScratch
 if cached==nil{scratch=new(callArgsScratch)}else{scratch=cached.(*callArgsScratch)}
 return scratch.values[:n],scratch
}
func releaseCallArgs(scratch *callArgsScratch){
 if scratch==nil{return}
 clear(scratch.values[:])
 callArgsPool.Put(scratch)
}
// A routed request asks for its callbacks to name it: the host serves them on
// the parked request whose goroutine raised them, not on whichever request
// holds the shared callback gate. The dispatching goroutine is the only link
// between the two, so it is recorded for the life of the request.
var routes = struct { sync.Mutex; active int; ids map[uint64]uint64 }{ids: map[uint64]uint64{}}
// callbackSliceFrames keeps the decoded backing arrays owned by an in-flight
// dependency call. A synchronous original callback publishes their current
// contents to the interpreter and applies its reply to these same arrays, so
// aliases already held by the dependency remain valid.
type callbackSliceFrame struct {buffers []sliceBuffer;args []reflect.Value}
var callbackSliceFrames = struct{sync.Mutex;frames map[uint64]*callbackSliceFrame}{frames:map[uint64]*callbackSliceFrame{}}
func goroutineID() uint64 {var b [64]byte;n:=bppRuntime.Stack(b[:],false);var id uint64;for _,c:=range b[len("goroutine "):n]{if c<'0'||c>'9'{break};id=id*10+uint64(c-'0')};return id}
func enterCallbackSliceFrame(buffers []sliceBuffer,args []reflect.Value)func(){if len(buffers)==0{return func(){}};g:=goroutineID();callbackSliceFrames.Lock();callbackSliceFrames.frames[g]=&callbackSliceFrame{buffers:buffers,args:args};callbackSliceFrames.Unlock();return func(){callbackSliceFrames.Lock();delete(callbackSliceFrames.frames,g);callbackSliceFrames.Unlock()}}
func callbackSliceSnapshot()[]sliceBuffer{g:=goroutineID();callbackSliceFrames.Lock();frame:=callbackSliceFrames.frames[g];callbackSliceFrames.Unlock();if frame==nil{return nil};out:=make([]sliceBuffer,len(frame.buffers));for i,buffer:=range frame.buffers{if buffer.Index<0||buffer.Index>=len(frame.args){continue};v:=frame.args[buffer.Index];out[i]=sliceBuffer{Index:buffer.Index,Length:v.Len(),Value:structural(v.Slice(0,v.Cap()))}};return out}
func applyCallbackSliceReply(buffers []sliceBuffer)error{g:=goroutineID();callbackSliceFrames.Lock();frame:=callbackSliceFrames.frames[g];callbackSliceFrames.Unlock();if frame==nil {if len(buffers)==0{return nil};return fmt.Errorf("callback slice frame expired")};if len(buffers)!=len(frame.buffers){return fmt.Errorf("callback slice refresh count mismatch")};for i,buffer:=range buffers{sent:=frame.buffers[i];if buffer.Index!=sent.Index||buffer.Index<0||buffer.Index>=len(frame.args){return fmt.Errorf("callback slice refresh index mismatch")};dst:=frame.args[buffer.Index];src,err:=decode(buffer.Value,dst.Type());if err!=nil{return err};if src.Kind()!=reflect.Slice||src.Len()!=dst.Len(){return fmt.Errorf("callback slice refresh shape mismatch")};reflect.Copy(dst,src)};return nil}
func routeEnter(parent uint64) func() {g:=goroutineID();routes.Lock();routes.ids[g]=parent;routes.active++;routes.Unlock();return func(){routes.Lock();delete(routes.ids,g);routes.active--;routes.Unlock()}}
func routeParent() uint64 {routes.Lock();active:=routes.active;routes.Unlock();if active==0{return 0};g:=goroutineID();routes.Lock();defer routes.Unlock();return routes.ids[g]}
//CALLBACKMAILBOX
func callback(selector string, recv value) ([]value,error) {
 outbound.Lock();encoder:=outbound.encoder;outbound.Unlock()
 if encoder==nil {return nil,fmt.Errorf("no interpreter connection for %s",selector)}
 callbacks.Lock();callbacks.next++;id:=callbacks.next;wait:=make(chan request,1);callbacks.waiting[id]=wait;callbacks.Unlock()
 defer func(){callbacks.Lock();delete(callbacks.waiting,id);callbacks.Unlock()}()
 message:=response{ID:id,Op:"callback",Selector:selector,Receiver:&recv,Parent:routeParent(),SliceUpdates:callbackSliceSnapshot()}
 var reply request;handled:=false;var err error
 if message.Parent==0 {reply,handled,err=mailboxCallback(message)}
 if err!=nil{return nil,err}
 if !handled {outbound.Lock();err=encoder.Encode(message);outbound.Unlock();if err!=nil{return nil,err};reply=<-wait}
 if handled && reply.Op=="callback-mailbox-overflow" && reply.Error=="" {select{case reply=<-wait:case <-handles.stop:return nil,fmt.Errorf("interpreter connection closed during callback")}}
 if reply.Receiver!=nil && recv.Origin!=0 {if _,err:=decode(*reply.Receiver,nil);err!=nil{return nil,err}}
 if reply.Error=="" {if err:=applyCallbackSliceReply(reply.SliceBuffers);err!=nil{return nil,err}}
 if reply.Error!=""{return nil,fmt.Errorf("%s",reply.Error)}
 // The original body ended by runtime.Goexit (a dependency call it made
 // ended its serving goroutine): end the goroutine that raised the callback.
 if len(reply.Values)==1 && reply.Values[0].Kind=="goexit" {bppRuntime.Goexit()}
 if len(reply.Values)==1 && reply.Values[0].Kind=="panic" {panic(originalCallbackPanic{reply.Values[0]})}
 return reply.Values,nil
}
// An implementation failure is also retained by the owning interpreter request;
// fmt may recover this panic, but it cannot convert that failed request to PASS.
func callbackFailed(err error) string {panic(err)}
type originalCallbackPanic struct {value value}
// dependencyStringPanic is a panic(string) raised by the dependency code a
// "call" request ran, the way reflect.MakeFunc or regexp.MustCompile panic:
// in Go the caller can recover that value, so it travels back as a program
// panic carrying the same string rather than as a bridge failure. Only the
// called function's own string panics qualify; the worker's validation
// errors, runtime errors and callback implementation failures keep their
// existing paths.
type dependencyStringPanic string
func callDependency(fn reflect.Value,args []reflect.Value,spread bool)(returned []reflect.Value){
 defer func(){if e:=recover();e!=nil{if text,ok:=e.(string);ok{panic(dependencyStringPanic(text))};panic(e)}}()
 if spread{return fn.CallSlice(args)}
 return fn.Call(args)
}
func(p originalCallbackPanic)Error()string{return stringText(p.value)}

func resolveType(name string) reflect.Type {
 if typ:=types[name];typ!=nil{return typ}
 if t:=types[localTypeKey(name)];t!=nil{return t}
 if t,ok:=seenTypes.Load(name);ok{return t.(reflect.Type)}
 // The interpreter spells a pointer to a value it was handed as "*" and the
 // identity it was handed — "*sync/atomic.Uint64" — which is not a Go
 // expression; the pointee identity resolves and the pointer is built on it.
 if len(name)>1&&name[0]=='*' {if element:=resolveType(name[1:]);element!=nil{return reflect.PointerTo(element)}}
 expression,err:=parser.ParseExpr(name);if err!=nil{return nil}
 var walk func(ast.Expr) reflect.Type
 walk=func(expr ast.Expr) reflect.Type {var canonical bytes.Buffer;if format.Node(&canonical,token.NewFileSet(),expr)==nil {if typ:=types[canonical.String()];typ!=nil{return typ}};switch e:=expr.(type){
 case *ast.StarExpr:element:=walk(e.X);if element!=nil{return reflect.PointerTo(element)}
 case *ast.FuncType:
  fields:=func(list *ast.FieldList)([]reflect.Type,bool,bool){var out []reflect.Type;variadic:=false;if list==nil{return out,false,true};for i,f:=range list.List{expr:=f.Type;if ell,ok:=expr.(*ast.Ellipsis);ok{if i!=len(list.List)-1{return nil,false,false};variadic=true;expr=&ast.ArrayType{Elt:ell.Elt}};typ:=walk(expr);if typ==nil{return nil,false,false};n:=len(f.Names);if n==0{n=1};for j:=0;j<n;j++{out=append(out,typ)}};return out,variadic,true}
  in,variadic,ok:=fields(e.Params);if !ok{return nil};out,resultVariadic,ok:=fields(e.Results);if !ok||resultVariadic{return nil};return reflect.FuncOf(in,out,variadic)
 case *ast.ChanType:element:=walk(e.Value);if element!=nil{direction:=reflect.BothDir;if e.Dir==ast.RECV{direction=reflect.RecvDir};if e.Dir==ast.SEND{direction=reflect.SendDir};return reflect.ChanOf(direction,element)}
 case *ast.Ident:return types[e.Name]
 case *ast.ArrayType:element:=walk(e.Elt);if element==nil{return nil};if e.Len==nil{return reflect.SliceOf(element)};if lit,ok:=e.Len.(*ast.BasicLit);ok{n,err:=strconv.Atoi(lit.Value);if err==nil&&n>=0{return reflect.ArrayOf(n,element)}}
 case *ast.MapType:key,element:=walk(e.Key),walk(e.Value);if key!=nil&&element!=nil&&key.Comparable(){return reflect.MapOf(key,element)}
 case *ast.InterfaceType:if len(e.Methods.List)==0{return reflect.TypeFor[any]()}
 case *ast.StructType:var fields []reflect.StructField;for _,field:=range e.Fields.List{typ:=walk(field.Type);if typ==nil{return nil};for _,name:=range field.Names{if !name.IsExported(){return nil};fields=append(fields,reflect.StructField{Name:name.Name,Type:typ})}};return reflect.StructOf(fields)
 case *ast.SelectorExpr:if prefix,ok:=e.X.(*ast.Ident);ok{return types[prefix.Name+"."+e.Sel.Name]}
 };return nil};return walk(expression)
}
// decode rebuilds one bridge value; pointee snapshots for the origins it
// registers are recorded once the WHOLE value graph is decoded, since a
// pointee reached through a back-reference is still being filled while its
// referrer decodes (bashpp_sprint165_runtime2_cycle.go).
type decodeState struct{ pointees []uint64; originDepth int }
func decode(v value, target reflect.Type)(reflect.Value,error){st:=&decodeState{};result,err:=decodeIn(st,v,target);if err==nil{originalPointers.Lock();ptrs:=make([]reflect.Value,len(st.pointees));for i,origin:=range st.pointees{ptrs[i]=originalPointers.values[origin]};originalPointers.Unlock();for i,origin:=range st.pointees{if ptrs[i].IsValid(){recordPointee(origin,ptrs[i])}}};return result,err}
func decodeRetainedStorage(v value)error{st:=&decodeState{originDepth:1};_,err:=decodeIn(st,v,nil);return err}
func decodeIn(st *decodeState, v value, target reflect.Type)(reflect.Value,error){
 var result reflect.Value
 if v.Kind=="nil" {
  typ:=target
  if v.Type!="" {typ=resolveType(v.Type);if typ==nil{return result,fmt.Errorf("unregistered nil bridge type %q",v.Type)}}
  if typ==nil{return reflect.Value{},nil}
  switch typ.Kind(){case reflect.Chan,reflect.Func,reflect.Interface,reflect.Map,reflect.Pointer,reflect.Slice:default:return result,fmt.Errorf("nil is not assignable to %s",typ)}
  result=reflect.Zero(typ)
  if target==nil||typ.AssignableTo(target){return result,nil}
  return reflect.Value{},fmt.Errorf("nil %s is not assignable to %s",typ,target)
 }
 // A lazily answered reflect.ValueOf (bashpp_s275_lazy_valueof.go) returned
 // by a callback: the operand decodes at ValueOf's own parameter type.
 if v.Kind=="valueof" {if len(v.Elements)!=1{return result,fmt.Errorf("valueof needs one operand")};operand,e:=decodeIn(st,v.Elements[0],reflect.TypeFor[any]());if e!=nil{return result,e};result=reflect.ValueOf(reflect.ValueOf(operand.Interface()))} else if v.Kind=="handle" {handles.Lock();result=handles.values[v.Handle];handles.Unlock();if !result.IsValid(){return result,fmt.Errorf("unknown native handle %d",v.Handle)}} else {
  typ:=resolveType(v.Type)
  if v.Type!="" && typ==nil {return result,fmt.Errorf("unregistered bridge type %q",v.Type)}
  // A scalar carrying a declared interface identity — an element of an
  // original ...any spread — decodes at its own kind; the interface stays
  // the assignability target below.
  if typ!=nil&&typ.Kind()==reflect.Interface{switch v.Kind{case "string","bool","int","uint","float","complex":typ=nil}}
  if typ==nil && target!=nil && target.Kind()!=reflect.Interface {typ=target}
  if typ==nil {switch v.Kind{case "string":typ=types["string"];case "bool":typ=types["bool"];case "int":typ=types["int"];case "uint":typ=types["uint"];case "float":typ=types["float64"];case "complex":typ=types["complex128"]}}
  if typ==nil{return result,fmt.Errorf("missing bridge type for %s",v.Kind)}
  result=reflect.New(typ).Elem()
  switch v.Kind {
  case "callback":
   if (target==nil||target.Kind()!=reflect.Func)&&typ!=nil&&typ.Kind()==reflect.Func{target=typ}
   if target==nil||target.Kind()!=reflect.Func{return result,fmt.Errorf("original callback requires a typed function parameter")}
   result=reflect.MakeFunc(target,func(args []reflect.Value)[]reflect.Value{
    inputs:=make([]value,len(args));for i,arg:=range args {inputs[i]=encode(arg)}
    returned,err:=callback("",value{Kind:"callback",Handle:v.Handle,Elements:inputs});if err!=nil{panic(err)}
    if len(returned)!=target.NumOut(){panic(fmt.Errorf("original callback result count mismatch"))}
    outputs:=make([]reflect.Value,len(returned));for i,item:=range returned {output,err:=decode(item,target.Out(i));if err!=nil{panic(err)};outputs[i]=output};return outputs
   })
   return result,nil
  case "string":if typ.Kind()!=reflect.String{return result,fmt.Errorf("string for %s",typ)};if v.Bytes!=nil{result.SetString(string(v.Bytes))}else{result.SetString(v.Text)}
  case "bool":b,e:=strconv.ParseBool(v.Text);if e!=nil||typ.Kind()!=reflect.Bool{return result,fmt.Errorf("invalid bool")};result.SetBool(b)
  case "int":n,e:=strconv.ParseInt(v.Text,10,64);if e!=nil{return result,e};switch typ.Kind(){case reflect.Int,reflect.Int8,reflect.Int16,reflect.Int32,reflect.Int64:if result.OverflowInt(n){return result,fmt.Errorf("integer overflow")};result.SetInt(n);case reflect.Uint,reflect.Uint8,reflect.Uint16,reflect.Uint32,reflect.Uint64,reflect.Uintptr:if n<0||result.OverflowUint(uint64(n)){return result,fmt.Errorf("unsigned overflow")};result.SetUint(uint64(n));case reflect.Float32,reflect.Float64:result.SetFloat(float64(n));case reflect.Complex64,reflect.Complex128:result.SetComplex(complex(float64(n),0));default:return result,fmt.Errorf("integer for %s",typ)}
  case "uint":n,e:=strconv.ParseUint(v.Text,10,64);if e!=nil{return result,e};switch typ.Kind(){case reflect.Uint,reflect.Uint8,reflect.Uint16,reflect.Uint32,reflect.Uint64,reflect.Uintptr:if result.OverflowUint(n){return result,fmt.Errorf("unsigned overflow")};result.SetUint(n);case reflect.Int,reflect.Int8,reflect.Int16,reflect.Int32,reflect.Int64:if n>1<<63-1||result.OverflowInt(int64(n)){return result,fmt.Errorf("integer overflow")};result.SetInt(int64(n));case reflect.Float32,reflect.Float64:result.SetFloat(float64(n));default:return result,fmt.Errorf("unsigned for %s",typ)}
  case "complex":n,e:=strconv.ParseComplex(v.Text,128);if e!=nil{return result,e};if typ.Kind()!=reflect.Complex64&&typ.Kind()!=reflect.Complex128{return result,fmt.Errorf("complex for %s",typ)};if result.OverflowComplex(n){return result,fmt.Errorf("complex overflow")};result.SetComplex(n)
  case "float":n,e:=strconv.ParseFloat(v.Text,64);if e!=nil{return result,e};switch typ.Kind(){case reflect.Float32,reflect.Float64:result.SetFloat(n);case reflect.Complex64,reflect.Complex128:result.SetComplex(complex(n,0));default:return result,fmt.Errorf("float for %s",typ)}
  case "slice","array":if typ.Kind()==reflect.Slice {length:=v.Length;capacity:=v.Capacity;if capacity<len(v.Elements){capacity=len(v.Elements)};if length>capacity||v.Offset<0{return result,fmt.Errorf("invalid slice view")};if st.originDepth>0&&v.Storage!=0{needed:=v.Offset+capacity;originalSlices.Lock();backing:=originalSlices.values[v.Storage];if backing.IsValid()&&(backing.Type()!=typ||backing.Cap()<needed){originalSlices.Unlock();return result,fmt.Errorf("retained slice storage cannot expand without invalidating existing selections")};if !backing.IsValid(){backing=reflect.MakeSlice(typ,needed,needed)};originalSlices.values[v.Storage]=backing.Slice3(0,needed,needed);originalSlices.Unlock();result=backing.Slice3(v.Offset,v.Offset+length,v.Offset+capacity)}else{result=reflect.MakeSlice(typ,length,capacity)}} else if typ.Kind()!=reflect.Array||typ.Len()!=len(v.Elements){return result,fmt.Errorf("invalid collection %s",typ)};write:=result;if typ.Kind()==reflect.Slice&&len(v.Elements)>result.Len(){write=result.Slice3(0,len(v.Elements),result.Cap())};for i,elem:=range v.Elements{item,e:=decodeIn(st,elem,typ.Elem());if e!=nil{return result,e};write.Index(i).Set(item)}
  case "pointer":if typ.Kind()!=reflect.Pointer{return result,fmt.Errorf("pointer for %s",typ)}
   // A back-reference: a pointer already on the interpreter's transport path
   // (a cycle) arrives with its origin and no pointee, and binds to the
   // storage registered for that origin before its pointee was decoded.
   if len(v.Elements)==0{if v.Origin==0{return result,fmt.Errorf("pointer needs one referent")};originalPointers.Lock();result=originalPointers.values[v.Origin];originalPointers.Unlock();if !result.IsValid()||result.Type()!=typ{return result,fmt.Errorf("pointer back-reference to an unregistered origin")};break}
   if len(v.Elements)!=1{return result,fmt.Errorf("pointer needs one referent")}
   // A pointer whose pointee is a native handle aliases the handle's own
   // storage: writes through the pointer land in the value later handle reads
   // observe, exactly as &x aliases x. No pointee writeback is registered —
   // the storage is dependency-owned, the interpreter holds only the handle.
   if v.Elements[0].Kind=="handle"{handles.Lock();h:=handles.values[v.Elements[0].Handle];handles.Unlock();if h.IsValid()&&h.CanAddr()&&h.Addr().Type()==typ{result=h.Addr();break}}
   // The storage is chosen and registered BEFORE the pointee is decoded, so
   // a pointee that refers back to this pointer resolves to it.
   // A pointer into an enclosing array is placed inside that array's one
   // allocation, so sibling subobjects keep Go's layout between them.
   placed:=placedPointer(v.Within,typ)
   originalPointers.Lock();if v.Origin!=0 {result=originalPointers.values[v.Origin]};if !result.IsValid() || result.Type()!=typ || result.IsNil(){result=placed;if !result.IsValid(){result=reflect.New(typ.Elem())}};if v.Origin!=0{originalPointers.values[v.Origin]=result;originalPointers.ids[result.Pointer()]=v.Origin;typedPointerOrigins[pointerKey{result.Pointer(),typ}]=v.Origin};originalPointers.Unlock()
   st.originDepth++;item,e:=decodeIn(st,v.Elements[0],typ.Elem());st.originDepth--;if e!=nil{return result,e};result.Elem().Set(item);if v.Origin!=0{st.pointees=append(st.pointees,v.Origin)}
  case "map":if typ.Kind()!=reflect.Map{return result,fmt.Errorf("map for %s",typ)};result=reflect.MakeMapWithSize(typ,len(v.Entries));for _,entry:=range v.Entries{key,e:=decodeIn(st,entry.Key,typ.Key());if e!=nil{return result,e};item,e:=decodeIn(st,entry.Value,typ.Elem());if e!=nil{return result,e};result.SetMapIndex(key,item)}
  case "struct":if typ.Kind()!=reflect.Struct{return result,fmt.Errorf("struct for %s",typ)};if len(v.Elements)>0&&(len(v.Fields)>0||len(v.Elements)!=typ.NumField()){return result,fmt.Errorf("invalid positional field count or mixed fields for %s",typ)};if codec,ok:=localStructCodecs[typ];ok{var err error;result,err=codec.decode(st,v);if err!=nil{return result,err};break};for name,field:=range v.Fields{slot:=result.FieldByName(name);if !slot.IsValid(){return result,fmt.Errorf("unknown field %s of %s",name,typ)};if !slot.CanSet(){return result,fmt.Errorf("unexported field %s of %s cannot cross the dependency boundary",name,typ)};item,e:=decodeIn(st,field,slot.Type());if e!=nil{return result,e};slot.Set(item)}
   for i,field:=range v.Elements{if i>=result.NumField(){return result,fmt.Errorf("too many values for %s",typ)};slot:=result.Field(i);if !slot.CanSet(){return result,fmt.Errorf("unexported field %s of %s cannot cross the dependency boundary",typ.Field(i).Name,typ)};item,e:=decodeIn(st,field,slot.Type());if e!=nil{return result,e};slot.Set(item)}
  default:return result,fmt.Errorf("unsupported bridge value %s",v.Kind)
  }
 }
 if target==nil{return result,nil}
 if result.Type().AssignableTo(target){return result,nil}
 // unsafe.Pointer(&x) crosses as the pointer it converts; the dependency's slot is the unsafe.Pointer.
 if target.Kind()==reflect.UnsafePointer&&result.Kind()==reflect.Pointer{p:=reflect.ValueOf(result.UnsafePointer());if p.Type().ConvertibleTo(target){return p.Convert(target),nil}}
 return result,fmt.Errorf("%s not assignable to %s",result.Type(),target)
}
// Structured access over a native value. Handles keep Go identity, so an
// original index/slice/field/len expression reads through the same value
// instead of materialising an interpreter copy.
// Bind value methods to a value snapshot; pointer methods retain the original
// native receiver. Exported field traversal never exposes unexported storage.
// Metadata belongs to the exact mirrored type, never its spelling. Keep
// reflect.Type itself unchanged so equality, assignability and method identity
// continue to use the same real type as native dependencies.
type originalTypeIdentity struct { Name, PackageName, PackagePath string }
var originalTypeIdentities = map[reflect.Type]originalTypeIdentity{}
func hasOriginalTypeIdentity(t reflect.Type) bool {
 if _,ok:=originalTypeIdentities[t];ok{return true}
 if t.Name()!="" {return false}
 switch t.Kind(){case reflect.Pointer,reflect.Slice,reflect.Array,reflect.Chan:return hasOriginalTypeIdentity(t.Elem());case reflect.Map:return hasOriginalTypeIdentity(t.Key())||hasOriginalTypeIdentity(t.Elem())}
 return false
}
func originalTypeString(t reflect.Type) string {
 if id,ok:=originalTypeIdentities[t];ok{return id.PackageName+"."+id.Name}
 if t.Name()!="" || !hasOriginalTypeIdentity(t) {return t.String()}
 switch t.Kind(){
 case reflect.Pointer:return "*"+originalTypeString(t.Elem())
 case reflect.Slice:return "[]"+originalTypeString(t.Elem())
 case reflect.Array:return "["+strconv.Itoa(t.Len())+"]"+originalTypeString(t.Elem())
 case reflect.Map:return "map["+originalTypeString(t.Key())+"]"+originalTypeString(t.Elem())
 case reflect.Chan:
  prefix:="chan ";if t.ChanDir()==reflect.RecvDir{prefix="<-chan "}else if t.ChanDir()==reflect.SendDir{prefix="chan<- "}
  elem:=originalTypeString(t.Elem())
  if t.ChanDir()==reflect.BothDir&&t.Elem().Name()==""&&t.Elem().Kind()==reflect.Chan&&t.Elem().ChanDir()==reflect.RecvDir{elem="("+elem+")"}
  return prefix+elem
 }
 return t.String()
}
// originalTypeFormat keeps a materialised interpreted type's source package
// spelling when it is itself formatted. The real reflect.Type remains the
// value used for equality, assignability, fields, methods and every reflected
// operation; this projection exists only at the fmt call boundary.
type originalTypeFormat struct{ reflect.Type }
func(t originalTypeFormat)String()string{return originalTypeString(t.Type)}
func formatUsesTypeVerb(format string)bool{
 for i:=0;i<len(format);i++ {if format[i]!='%'{continue};i++;if i<len(format)&&format[i]=='%'{continue};for ;i<len(format);i++ {c:=format[i];if c=='T'{return true};if c>='A'&&c<='Z'||c>='a'&&c<='z'{break}}}
 return false
}
// originalFmtProjection returns the formatting projection of one argument and
// reports whether it differs from the argument itself. Only a materialised
// interpreted reflect.Type diverges, so every other value is handed to the
// dependency exactly as the interpreter sent it.
func originalFmtProjection(v reflect.Value)(reflect.Value,bool){
 if !v.IsValid(){return v,false}
 elem:=v
 if elem.Kind()==reflect.Interface&&!elem.IsNil(){elem=elem.Elem()}
 if !elem.CanInterface(){return v,false}
 typ,ok:=elem.Interface().(reflect.Type);if !ok||!hasOriginalTypeIdentity(typ){return v,false}
 return reflect.ValueOf(originalTypeFormat{typ}),true
}
// Project only type directives, leaving their operands intact for other verbs
// (including indexed reuse and Errorf's %w). Explicit indices preserve fmt's
// argument cursor after a projected directive selects an added type string. Invalid
// formats stay with fmt so its diagnostics are not reinterpreted here.
func originalFmtTypeVerbs(format string, operands []reflect.Value) (string, []reflect.Value) {
 var projected []reflect.Value
 var out strings.Builder
 next,changed,reordered:=0,false,false
 index:=func(n int)string{return "["+strconv.Itoa(n+1)+"]"}
 for i:=0;i<len(format); {
  if format[i]!='%' {out.WriteByte(format[i]);i++;continue}
  i++
  var directive strings.Builder
  directive.WriteByte('%')
  for i<len(format)&&strings.ContainsRune("#0+- ",rune(format[i])){directive.WriteByte(format[i]);i++}
  afterIndex:=false
  readIndex:=func()bool{
   afterIndex=false
   if i>=len(format)||format[i]!='[' {return true}
   end:=strings.IndexByte(format[i:],']');if end<0{return false}
   n,err:=strconv.Atoi(format[i+1:i+end]);if err!=nil||n<1||n>len(operands){return false}
   next=n-1;i+=end+1;afterIndex=true;reordered=true;return true
  }
  if !readIndex(){return format,nil}
  if i<len(format)&&format[i]=='*' {
   if next>=len(operands){return format,nil};directive.WriteString(index(next));directive.WriteByte('*');next++;i++;afterIndex=false
  }else{
   start:=i;for i<len(format)&&format[i]>='0'&&format[i]<='9'{i++}
   if afterIndex&&i>start{return format,nil};directive.WriteString(format[start:i])
  }
  if i+1<len(format)&&format[i]=='.' {
   if afterIndex{return format,nil};directive.WriteByte('.');i++
   if !readIndex(){return format,nil}
   if i<len(format)&&format[i]=='*' {
    if next>=len(operands){return format,nil};directive.WriteString(index(next));directive.WriteByte('*');next++;i++;afterIndex=false
   }else{start:=i;for i<len(format)&&format[i]>='0'&&format[i]<='9'{i++};directive.WriteString(format[start:i])}
  }
  if !afterIndex&&!readIndex(){return format,nil}
  if i>=len(format){return format,nil}
  verb,size:=utf8.DecodeRuneInString(format[i:]);i+=size
  if verb=='%' {directive.WriteByte('%');out.WriteString(directive.String());continue}
  if next>=len(operands){return format,nil}
  operand:=next;next++
  v:=operands[operand]
  for v.IsValid()&&v.Kind()==reflect.Interface&&!v.IsNil(){v=v.Elem()}
  if verb=='T'&&v.IsValid()&&hasOriginalTypeIdentity(v.Type()) {
   directive.WriteString(index(len(operands)+len(projected)));directive.WriteByte('s')
   projected=append(projected,reflect.ValueOf(originalTypeString(v.Type())))
   out.WriteString(directive.String());changed=true
  }else{directive.WriteString(index(operand));directive.WriteRune(verb);out.WriteString(directive.String())}
 }
 if !changed{return format,nil}
 // Explicit indexing suppresses fmt's extra-argument diagnostic. Preserve it
 // for originally sequential formats, including the values' normal methods.
 if !reordered&&next<len(operands){return format,nil}
 return out.String(),projected
}
func originalFmtArgs(fn reflect.Value,args []reflect.Value,spread bool)[]reflect.Value{
 same:=func(target any)bool{return fn.IsValid()&&fn.Pointer()==reflect.ValueOf(target).Pointer()}
 formatIndex,first:=-1,-1
 switch {case same(fmt.Printf),same(fmt.Sprintf),same(fmt.Errorf):formatIndex,first=0,1;case same(fmt.Fprintf),same(fmt.Appendf):formatIndex,first=1,2;default:return args}
 if formatIndex>=len(args)||args[formatIndex].Kind()!=reflect.String{return args}
 if formatUsesTypeVerb(args[formatIndex].String()) {
  operands:=args[first:]
  if spread&&len(operands)==1&&operands[0].Kind()==reflect.Slice {src:=operands[0];operands=make([]reflect.Value,src.Len());for i:=range operands{operands[i]=src.Index(i)}}
  format,projected:=originalFmtTypeVerbs(args[formatIndex].String(),operands)
  if len(projected)==0{return args}
  out:=append([]reflect.Value(nil),args...);out[formatIndex]=reflect.ValueOf(format)
  if spread {
   src:=args[first];dst:=reflect.MakeSlice(src.Type(),src.Len()+len(projected),src.Len()+len(projected));reflect.Copy(dst,src)
   for i,v:=range projected{dst.Index(src.Len()+i).Set(v)};out[first]=dst
  }else{out=append(out,projected...)}
  return out
 }
 // The projection is materialised lazily. A spread variadic slice is still the
 // interpreter's own backing array, shared with the callback slice frame, so
 // replacing it with a copy would hide a mutation made by a synchronous
 // original callback running mid-format; it is only copied once an element
 // actually needs the projection, and never otherwise.
 if spread&&len(args)==first+1&&args[first].Kind()==reflect.Slice {
  src:=args[first];var dst reflect.Value
  for i:=range src.Len() {
   projected,differs:=originalFmtProjection(src.Index(i));if !differs{continue}
   if !dst.IsValid(){dst=reflect.MakeSlice(src.Type(),src.Len(),src.Len());reflect.Copy(dst,src)}
   slot:=dst.Index(i);if projected.Type().AssignableTo(slot.Type())||slot.Kind()==reflect.Interface&&projected.Type().Implements(slot.Type()){slot.Set(projected)}
  }
  if !dst.IsValid(){return args}
  out:=append([]reflect.Value(nil),args...);out[first]=dst;return out
 }
 var out []reflect.Value
 for i:=first;i<len(args);i++ {
  projected,differs:=originalFmtProjection(args[i]);if !differs{continue}
  if out==nil{out=append([]reflect.Value(nil),args...)}
  out[i]=projected
 }
 if out==nil{return args}
 return out
}
func memberMethod(rv reflect.Value,name string) reflect.Value {
 for rv.IsValid()&&rv.Kind()==reflect.Interface&&!rv.IsNil(){rv=rv.Elem()}
 if !rv.IsValid(){return reflect.Value{}}
 if rv.CanInterface(){if typ,ok:=rv.Interface().(reflect.Type);ok {
  if id,mapped:=originalTypeIdentities[typ];mapped {switch name {case "Name":return reflect.ValueOf(func()string{return id.Name});case "PkgPath":return reflect.ValueOf(func()string{return id.PackagePath})}}
  if name=="String" {return reflect.ValueOf(func()string{return originalTypeString(typ)})}
 }}

 if method:=rv.MethodByName(name);method.IsValid(){snapshot:=reflect.New(rv.Type()).Elem();snapshot.Set(rv);return snapshot.MethodByName(name)}
 if rv.CanAddr(){return rv.Addr().MethodByName(name)}
 return reflect.Value{}
}
func callbackProofTypeName(typ reflect.Type) string {
 prefix:="";for typ.Kind()==reflect.Pointer {prefix+="*";typ=typ.Elem()}
 if typ.Name()==""||typ.PkgPath()==""{return ""}
 return prefix+typ.PkgPath()+"."+typ.Name()
}
func callbackProofReceiverTypes(root reflect.Value,method string)(names []string,err error){
 const maxNodes=4096
 types:=make(map[string]bool);seen:=make(map[uintptr]bool);nodes:=0
 var walk func(reflect.Value,int)error
 walk=func(v reflect.Value,depth int)error{
  if !v.IsValid(){return nil};if depth>64{return fmt.Errorf("callback proof receiver graph exceeds depth bound")};nodes++;if nodes>maxNodes{return fmt.Errorf("callback proof receiver graph exceeds node bound")}
  for v.Kind()==reflect.Interface {if v.IsNil(){return nil};v=v.Elem()}
  if _,ok:=v.Type().MethodByName(method);ok {name:=callbackProofTypeName(v.Type());if name==""{return fmt.Errorf("callback proof observed unnamed method receiver %s",v.Type())};types[name]=true}
  switch v.Kind(){
  case reflect.Pointer:
   if v.IsNil(){return nil};ptr:=v.Pointer();if seen[ptr]{return nil};seen[ptr]=true;return walk(v.Elem(),depth+1)
  case reflect.Struct:
   for i:=0;i<v.NumField();i++{if err:=walk(v.Field(i),depth+1);err!=nil{return err}}
  case reflect.Array,reflect.Slice:
   if v.Kind()==reflect.Slice&&!v.IsNil(){ptr:=v.Pointer();if ptr!=0&&seen[ptr]{return nil};if ptr!=0{seen[ptr]=true}}
   for i:=0;i<v.Len();i++{if err:=walk(v.Index(i),depth+1);err!=nil{return err}}
  case reflect.Map:
   if v.IsNil(){return nil};ptr:=v.Pointer();if seen[ptr]{return nil};seen[ptr]=true;iter:=v.MapRange();for iter.Next(){if err:=walk(iter.Key(),depth+1);err!=nil{return err};if err:=walk(iter.Value(),depth+1);err!=nil{return err}}
  }
  return nil
 }
 if err:=walk(root,0);err!=nil{return nil,err};for name:=range types{names=append(names,name)};sort.Strings(names);if len(names)==0{return nil,fmt.Errorf("callback proof found no concrete method receiver")};return names,nil
}
func nativeSignatureTypeIdentity(t reflect.Type)string{
 if id,ok:=originalTypeIdentities[t];ok&&id.PackagePath!="" {return id.PackagePath+"."+id.Name}
 if t.Name()!="" {if path:=t.PkgPath();path!="" {return path+"."+t.Name()};return t.String()}
 switch t.Kind(){
 case reflect.Interface:if t.NumMethod()==0{return "interface{}"}
 case reflect.Pointer:return "*"+nativeSignatureTypeIdentity(t.Elem())
 case reflect.Slice:return "[]"+nativeSignatureTypeIdentity(t.Elem())
 case reflect.Array:return "["+strconv.FormatInt(int64(t.Len()),10)+"]"+nativeSignatureTypeIdentity(t.Elem())
 case reflect.Map:return "map["+nativeSignatureTypeIdentity(t.Key())+"]"+nativeSignatureTypeIdentity(t.Elem())
 case reflect.Chan:prefix:="chan ";if t.ChanDir()==reflect.RecvDir{prefix="<-chan "}else if t.ChanDir()==reflect.SendDir{prefix="chan<- "};return prefix+nativeSignatureTypeIdentity(t.Elem())
 case reflect.Func:return "func("+nativeMethodSignatureIdentity(t,0,false)+")"
 }
 return t.String()
}
func nativeMethodSignatureIdentity(t reflect.Type,start int,outer bool)string{
 params:=make([]string,0,t.NumIn()-start)
 for i:=start;i<t.NumIn();i++ {typ:=t.In(i);if t.IsVariadic()&&i==t.NumIn()-1{params=append(params,"..."+nativeSignatureTypeIdentity(typ.Elem()))}else{params=append(params,nativeSignatureTypeIdentity(typ))}}
 results:=make([]string,t.NumOut());for i:=range results{results[i]=nativeSignatureTypeIdentity(t.Out(i))}
 sep:="->";if !outer{sep=")("}
 return strings.Join(params,",")+sep+strings.Join(results,",")
}
func samePackagePrivateField(rv reflect.Value,name,pkg string)(reflect.Value,bool){
 if pkg==""||rv.Kind()!=reflect.Struct{return reflect.Value{},false}
 field,ok:=rv.Type().FieldByName(name);if !ok||field.PkgPath==""||field.PkgPath!=pkg{return reflect.Value{},false}
 value:=rv.FieldByIndex(field.Index)
 if !value.CanAddr(){copy:=reflect.New(rv.Type()).Elem();copy.Set(rv);value=copy.FieldByIndex(field.Index)}
 if !value.CanAddr(){return reflect.Value{},false}
 return reflect.NewAt(value.Type(),unsafe.Pointer(value.UnsafeAddr())).Elem(),true
}
func access(rv reflect.Value,q request)([]value,string){
 // Interface admission asks for the type's method set, not an addressable
 // value's auto-addressed bound methods. No receiver or function is retained.
 if q.Op=="method-type" {typ:=rv.Type();method,ok:=typ.MethodByName(q.Selector);if !ok{return nil,"unknown exported method "+q.Selector};start:=1;if typ.Kind()==reflect.Interface{start=0};in:=make([]reflect.Type,method.Type.NumIn()-start);for i:=range in{in[i]=method.Type.In(i+start)};out:=make([]reflect.Type,method.Type.NumOut());for i:=range out{out[i]=method.Type.Out(i)};sig:=reflect.FuncOf(in,out,method.Type.IsVariadic());result:=encode(reflect.ValueOf(sig.String()));result.Signature=nativeMethodSignatureIdentity(method.Type,start,true);return []value{result},""}

 if q.Op=="byte-set" {if rv.Kind()!=reflect.Slice||rv.Type().Elem().Kind()!=reflect.Uint8||len(q.Args)!=2{return nil,"native indexed writes require a byte slice"};index,err:=decode(q.Args[0],nil);if err!=nil{return nil,err.Error()};var i int64;switch index.Kind(){case reflect.Int,reflect.Int8,reflect.Int16,reflect.Int32,reflect.Int64:i=index.Int();case reflect.Uint,reflect.Uint8,reflect.Uint16,reflect.Uint32,reflect.Uint64:if index.Uint()>uint64(rv.Len()){return nil,"byte index out of range"};i=int64(index.Uint());default:return nil,"byte index must be an integer"};if i<0||i>=int64(rv.Len()){return nil,"byte index out of range"};element,err:=decode(q.Args[1],rv.Type().Elem());if err!=nil{return nil,err.Error()};rv.Index(int(i)).Set(element);return []value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(true))},""}

 if rv.Kind()==reflect.Interface&&!rv.IsNil(){rv=rv.Elem()}
 if q.Op=="field-set" {
  if len(q.Args)!=1{return nil,"native field writes require one value"}
  for rv.Kind()==reflect.Pointer {if rv.IsNil(){return nil,"runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference"};rv=rv.Elem()}
  if rv.Kind()!=reflect.Struct{return nil,"native field writes require a struct"}
  field:=rv.FieldByName(q.Selector)
  if !field.IsValid(){return nil,"unknown exported member "+q.Selector+" of "+rv.Type().String()}
  if !field.CanSet()||!field.CanInterface(){return nil,"unexported field "+q.Selector}
  decoded,err:=decode(q.Args[0],field.Type());if err!=nil{return nil,err.Error()}
  field.Set(decoded)
  return []value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(true))},""
 }
 if q.Op=="deref-set" {
  if len(q.Args)!=1{return nil,"pointee writes require one value"}
  if rv.Kind()!=reflect.Pointer{return nil,"pointee writes require a pointer"}
  if rv.IsNil(){return nil,"runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference"}
  target:=rv.Elem()
  if !target.CanSet(){return nil,"pointee is not addressable"}
  decoded,err:=decode(q.Args[0],target.Type());if err!=nil{return nil,err.Error()}
  target.Set(decoded)
  return []value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(true))},""
 }
 if q.Op=="field-pointer" {
  for rv.Kind()==reflect.Pointer {if rv.IsNil(){return nil,"runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference"};rv=rv.Elem()}
  if rv.Kind()!=reflect.Struct{return nil,"native field address requires a struct"}
  field:=rv.FieldByName(q.Selector)
  if !field.IsValid(){return nil,"unknown exported member "+q.Selector+" of "+rv.Type().String()}
  if !field.CanInterface(){return nil,"unexported field "+q.Selector}
  if !field.CanAddr(){return nil,"field "+q.Selector+" is not addressable"}
  return []value{encode(field.Addr())},""
 }
 if q.Op=="field"||q.Op=="member"||q.Op=="receiver_field" {
  original:=rv
  for rv.Kind()==reflect.Pointer {if rv.IsNil(){if q.Op=="member" {if method:=memberMethod(original,q.Selector);method.IsValid(){return []value{encode(method)},""}};return nil,"runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference"};rv=rv.Elem()}
  if rv.Kind()==reflect.Struct {
   f:=rv.FieldByName(q.Selector)
   if f.IsValid(){if !f.CanInterface(){var ok bool;f,ok=samePackagePrivateField(rv,q.Selector,q.AccessPackage);if !ok{return nil,"unexported field "+q.Selector}};encoded:=encode(f)
    if q.Op=="receiver_field"&&encoded.Kind=="handle"&&f.CanAddr(){handles.Lock();handles.values[encoded.Handle]=f;handles.Unlock();encoded.NativeTypeID=nativeTypeToken(f.Type())}
    return []value{encoded},""}
  }
  if q.Op=="member" {if method:=memberMethod(original,q.Selector);method.IsValid(){return []value{encode(method)},""}}
  return nil,"unknown exported member "+q.Selector+" of "+original.Type().String()
 }
 for q.Op!="deref"&&rv.Kind()==reflect.Pointer&&rv.Type().Elem().Kind()==reflect.Array {if rv.IsNil(){return nil,"index through nil pointer"};rv=rv.Elem()}
 switch q.Op {
 case "kind":
  // The original program's `range` needs to know whether it is iterating keys
  // or indexes before it asks for either. Only the reflect kind crosses.
  return []value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(rv.Kind().String()))},""
 case "keys":
  if rv.Kind()!=reflect.Map{return nil,"range keys are not defined on "+rv.Type().String()}
  keys:=rv.MapKeys();out:=make([]value,0,len(keys));for _,key:=range keys{out=append(out,encode(key))};return out,""
 case "deref":
  for rv.Kind()==reflect.Interface&&!rv.IsNil(){rv=rv.Elem()}
  if rv.Kind()!=reflect.Pointer{return nil,"dereference requires a pointer"}
  if rv.IsNil(){return nil,"invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference"}
  return []value{encode(rv.Elem())},""
 case "len":
  switch rv.Kind(){case reflect.String,reflect.Slice,reflect.Array,reflect.Map,reflect.Chan:return []value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(rv.Len()))},""}
  return nil,"len is not defined on "+rv.Type().String()
 case "cap":
  switch rv.Kind(){case reflect.Slice,reflect.Array,reflect.Chan:return []value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(rv.Cap()))},""}
  return nil,"cap is not defined on "+rv.Type().String()
 case "index":
  if len(q.Args)!=1{return nil,"index requires one operand"}
  if rv.Kind()==reflect.Map{key,err:=decode(q.Args[0],rv.Type().Key());if err!=nil{return nil,err.Error()};item:=rv.MapIndex(key);if !item.IsValid(){item=reflect.Zero(rv.Type().Elem())};return []value{encode(item)},""}
  n,err:=strconv.Atoi(q.Args[0].Text);if err!=nil{return nil,"index is not an integer"}
  switch rv.Kind(){case reflect.String,reflect.Slice,reflect.Array:default:return nil,"index is not defined on "+rv.Type().String()}
  if n<0||n>=rv.Len(){return nil,fmt.Sprintf("index out of range [%d] with length %d",n,rv.Len())}
  if rv.Kind()==reflect.String{return []value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(rv.String()[n]))},""}
  return []value{encode(rv.Index(n))},""
 case "index-set":
  // An indexed write through a dependency-owned map or slice stores the
  // decoded value in that same storage, at the element type it declares.
  if len(q.Args)!=2{return nil,"index-set requires a key and a value"}
  if rv.Kind()==reflect.Map{if rv.IsNil(){return nil,"assignment to entry in nil map"};key,err:=decode(q.Args[0],rv.Type().Key());if err!=nil{return nil,err.Error()};element,err:=decode(q.Args[1],rv.Type().Elem());if err!=nil{return nil,err.Error()};rv.SetMapIndex(key,element);return []value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(true))},""}
  switch rv.Kind(){case reflect.Slice,reflect.Array:default:return nil,"indexed writes are not defined on "+rv.Type().String()}
  n,err:=strconv.Atoi(q.Args[0].Text);if err!=nil{return nil,"index is not an integer"}
  if n<0||n>=rv.Len(){return nil,fmt.Sprintf("index out of range [%d] with length %d",n,rv.Len())}
  target:=rv.Index(n);if !target.CanSet(){return nil,"indexed value is not addressable"}
  element,err:=decode(q.Args[1],target.Type());if err!=nil{return nil,err.Error()}
  target.Set(element);return []value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(true))},""
 case "index-pointer":
  if len(q.Args)!=1{return nil,"index-pointer requires one operand"}
  for rv.Kind()==reflect.Pointer {if rv.IsNil(){return nil,"runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference"};rv=rv.Elem()}
  switch rv.Kind(){case reflect.Slice:case reflect.Array:if !rv.CanAddr(){return nil,"indexed value is not addressable"};default:return nil,"index-pointer is not defined on "+rv.Type().String()}
  n,err:=strconv.Atoi(q.Args[0].Text);if err!=nil{return nil,"index is not an integer"}
  if n<0||n>=rv.Len(){return nil,fmt.Sprintf("index out of range [%d] with length %d",n,rv.Len())}
  element:=rv.Index(n);if !element.CanAddr(){return nil,"indexed value is not addressable"}
  return []value{encode(element.Addr())},""
 case "unsafe-slice":
  if len(q.Args)!=1{return nil,"unsafe-slice requires a length"}
  if rv.Kind()!=reflect.Pointer||rv.IsNil(){return nil,"unsafe.Slice: ptr is nil"}
  n,err:=strconv.Atoi(q.Args[0].Text);if err!=nil||n<0{return nil,"unsafe.Slice: len out of range"}
  array:=reflect.NewAt(reflect.ArrayOf(n,rv.Type().Elem()),unsafe.Pointer(rv.Pointer())).Elem()
  return []value{encode(array.Slice(0,n))},""
 case "slice":
  if (len(q.Args)!=2&&len(q.Args)!=3){return nil,"slice requires two or three bounds"}
  switch rv.Kind(){case reflect.String,reflect.Slice,reflect.Array:default:return nil,"slice is not defined on "+rv.Type().String()}
  if rv.Kind()==reflect.Array&&!rv.CanAddr(){return nil,"unaddressable array slice"}
  low,high:=0,rv.Len()
  if q.Args[0].Kind!="nil"{n,err:=strconv.Atoi(q.Args[0].Text);if err!=nil{return nil,"slice bound is not an integer"};low=n}
  if q.Args[1].Kind!="nil"{n,err:=strconv.Atoi(q.Args[1].Text);if err!=nil{return nil,"slice bound is not an integer"};high=n}
  capacity:=rv.Len();if rv.Kind()==reflect.Slice{capacity=rv.Cap()}
  if low<0||high<low||high>capacity{return nil,fmt.Sprintf("slice bounds out of range [%d:%d] with capacity %d",low,high,capacity)}
  if len(q.Args)==3 {if rv.Kind()!=reflect.Slice{return nil,"three-index slice requires slice storage"};maximum,err:=strconv.Atoi(q.Args[2].Text);if err!=nil||maximum<high||maximum>capacity{return nil,"invalid three-index slice capacity"};return []value{encode(rv.Slice3(low,high,maximum))},""}
  return []value{encode(rv.Slice(low,high))},""
 }
 return nil,"unsupported native access "+q.Op
}
func sourceLog(q request,args []reflect.Value)(bool,string){
 if q.SourceFile==""||q.SourceLine==0||q.LogPrint==""{return false,""}
 values:=make([]any,len(args));for i,arg:=range args{values[i]=arg.Interface()}
 message:="";switch q.LogPrint{case "Print":message=fmt.Sprint(values...);case "Println":message=fmt.Sprintln(values...);case "Printf":if len(values)==0{return true,"missing format"};format,ok:=values[0].(string);if !ok{return true,"format is not a string"};message=fmt.Sprintf(format,values[1:]...);default:return false,""}
 if message==""||message[len(message)-1]!='\n'{message+="\n"}
 flags:=bppLog.Flags();now:=time.Now();var b bytes.Buffer;b.WriteString(bppLog.Prefix())
 if flags&bppLog.Ldate!=0{y,m,d:=now.Date();fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%04d/%02d/%02d ",y,m,d)}
 if flags&(bppLog.Ltime|bppLog.Lmicroseconds)!=0{h,m,s:=now.Clock();fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%02d:%02d:%02d",h,m,s);if flags&bppLog.Lmicroseconds!=0{fmt.Fprintf(&b,".%06d",now.Nanosecond()/1000)};b.WriteByte(' ')}
 if flags&(bppLog.Lshortfile|bppLog.Llongfile)!=0{file:=q.SourceFile;if flags&bppLog.Lshortfile!=0{file=filepath.Base(file)};fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%s:%d: ",file,q.SourceLine)}
 b.WriteString(message);_,err:=bppLog.Writer().Write(b.Bytes());if err!=nil{return true,err.Error()};return true,""
}
// A tree containing any function identifier or template invocation is outside
// the read-only primitive-slice contract, regardless of its Funcs registry.
func primitiveTemplateTree(node bppTemplateParse.Node)bool {
 if node==nil{return true}
 switch n:=node.(type) {
 case *bppTemplateParse.ListNode:if n==nil{return true};for _,child:=range n.Nodes{if !primitiveTemplateTree(child){return false}};return true
 case *bppTemplateParse.ActionNode:return primitiveTemplateTree(n.Pipe)
 case *bppTemplateParse.PipeNode:for _,command:=range n.Cmds{if !primitiveTemplateTree(command){return false}};return true
 case *bppTemplateParse.CommandNode:for _,arg:=range n.Args{if !primitiveTemplateTree(arg){return false}};return true
 case *bppTemplateParse.IfNode:return primitiveTemplateTree(n.Pipe)&&primitiveTemplateTree(n.List)&&primitiveTemplateTree(n.ElseList)
 case *bppTemplateParse.RangeNode:return primitiveTemplateTree(n.Pipe)&&primitiveTemplateTree(n.List)&&primitiveTemplateTree(n.ElseList)
 case *bppTemplateParse.WithNode:return primitiveTemplateTree(n.Pipe)&&primitiveTemplateTree(n.List)&&primitiveTemplateTree(n.ElseList)
 case *bppTemplateParse.TextNode,*bppTemplateParse.DotNode,*bppTemplateParse.StringNode,*bppTemplateParse.NumberNode,*bppTemplateParse.BoolNode,*bppTemplateParse.NilNode,*bppTemplateParse.VariableNode,*bppTemplateParse.FieldNode:return true
 }
 return false
}
func dispatch(q request)(reply response){
 reply.ID=q.ID
 defer func(){if e:=recover();e!=nil{if original,ok:=e.(originalCallbackPanic);ok{reply.Panic=&original.value}else if raised,ok:=e.(dependencyStringPanic);ok{reply.Panic=&value{Kind:"panic",Type:"string",Text:string(raised),Bytes:[]byte(string(raised))}}else{reply.Error=fmt.Sprintf("native dependency panic: %v",e)}}}()
 if q.Op=="origin-refresh" {
  if q.Receiver!=nil||len(q.Args)!=1||q.Args[0].Kind!="pointer"||q.Args[0].Origin==0{reply.Error="origin refresh requires one authenticated pointer";return}
  if _,err:=decode(q.Args[0],nil);err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error()};return
 }
 if q.Op=="storage-refresh" {
  if q.Receiver!=nil||len(q.Args)!=1||q.Args[0].Kind!="slice"||q.Args[0].Storage==0{reply.Error="storage refresh requires one authenticated slice";return}
  if err:=decodeRetainedStorage(q.Args[0]);err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error()};return
 }
 if q.Op=="channel-make" {
  typ:=resolveType(q.Selector);if typ==nil||typ.Kind()!=reflect.Chan||len(q.Args)!=1{reply.Error="channel make requires one capacity and a registered channel type";return}
  n,err:=strconv.Atoi(q.Args[0].Text);if err!=nil||n<0{panic("makechan: size out of range")}
  channel:=reflect.MakeChan(reflect.ChanOf(reflect.BothDir,typ.Elem()),n);if channel.Type()!=typ{channel=channel.Convert(typ)}
  reply.Values=[]value{encode(channel)};return
 }

 if q.Op=="channel-bind" {
  typ:=resolveType(q.Selector);if typ==nil||typ.Kind()!=reflect.Chan||len(q.Args)!=1{reply.Error="channel binding requires a registered channel type and one value";return}
  original,err:=decode(q.Args[0],nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return}
  if !original.IsValid()||original.Kind()!=reflect.Chan||!original.Type().AssignableTo(typ){reply.Error="channel value is not assignable to declared type";return}
  bound:=reflect.New(typ).Elem();bound.Set(original);reply.Values=[]value{encode(bound)};return
 }
 if q.Op=="channel-close" {
  if q.Receiver==nil{reply.Error="channel close lacks receiver";return};channel,err:=decode(*q.Receiver,nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return}
  if !channel.IsValid()||channel.Kind()!=reflect.Chan||channel.Type().ChanDir()==reflect.RecvDir{reply.Error="channel close requires a send-capable channel";return};channel.Close();return
 }
 if q.Op=="channel-type" {
  if q.Receiver==nil{reply.Error="channel type query lacks receiver";return}
  channel,err:=decode(*q.Receiver,nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};target:=resolveType(q.Selector)
  if !channel.IsValid()||channel.Kind()!=reflect.Chan||target==nil||target.Kind()!=reflect.Chan{reply.Error="channel type query requires registered channel types";return}
  reply.Values=[]value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(channel.Type().AssignableTo(target)))};return
 }
 if q.Op=="channel-select" {
  if q.Selector!=""&&q.Selector!="probe"{reply.Error="invalid native select mode";return}
  cases:=make([]reflect.SelectCase,0,len(q.Args)+1)
  for _,arm:=range q.Args {
   if len(arm.Elements)<1{reply.Error="channel select arm lacks a channel";return}
   channel,err:=decode(arm.Elements[0],nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return}
   if !channel.IsValid()||channel.Kind()!=reflect.Chan{reply.Error="native channel operand required";return}
   switch arm.Kind {
   case "recv":if channel.Type().ChanDir()==reflect.SendDir{reply.Error="receive on send-only channel";return};cases=append(cases,reflect.SelectCase{Dir:reflect.SelectRecv,Chan:channel})
   case "send":if channel.Type().ChanDir()==reflect.RecvDir{reply.Error="send on receive-only channel";return};if len(arm.Elements)!=2{reply.Error="channel send requires one value";return};v,err:=decode(arm.Elements[1],channel.Type().Elem());if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};cases=append(cases,reflect.SelectCase{Dir:reflect.SelectSend,Chan:channel,Send:v})
   default:reply.Error="invalid native select arm";return
   }
  }
  if q.Selector=="probe"{cases=append(cases,reflect.SelectCase{Dir:reflect.SelectDefault})}
  stopIndex:=len(cases);cases=append(cases,reflect.SelectCase{Dir:reflect.SelectRecv,Chan:reflect.ValueOf(handles.stop)})
  chosen,received,open:=reflect.Select(cases)
  if chosen==stopIndex{reply.Error="native channel session closed";return}
  if q.Selector=="probe"&&chosen==len(q.Args){chosen=-1}
  item:=value{Kind:"nil"};if received.IsValid(){item=encode(received)}
  reply.Values=[]value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(chosen)),item,encode(reflect.ValueOf(open))};return
 }
 if q.Op=="is-nil" {if len(q.Args)!=1{reply.Error="nil query requires one value";return};v,err:=decode(q.Args[0],nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};isNil:=false;if !v.IsValid(){isNil=true}else if q.Args[0].Interface!=""&&v.Kind()!=reflect.Interface{isNil=false}else{switch v.Kind(){case reflect.Chan,reflect.Func,reflect.Interface,reflect.Map,reflect.Pointer,reflect.Slice,reflect.UnsafePointer:isNil=v.IsNil()}};reply.Values=[]value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(isNil))};return}
 if q.Op=="equal" {if len(q.Args)!=2{reply.Error="comparison requires two values";return};left,err:=decode(q.Args[0],nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};right,err:=decode(q.Args[1],nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};equal:=false
 // A nil interface crosses as an invalid value; a non-nil interface crosses
 // as its dynamic value with the Interface marker set. That marker decides
 // the comparison before the dynamic kind does: an interface holding any
 // value -- a struct such as go/types.Error as much as a typed nil pointer --
 // is never equal to nil. Only an unmarked nilable value asks its own IsNil.
 if !left.IsValid()||!right.IsValid(){other,marked:=left,q.Args[0].Interface!="";if !other.IsValid(){other,marked=right,q.Args[1].Interface!=""};if !other.IsValid(){equal=true}else if marked&&other.Kind()!=reflect.Interface{equal=false}else{switch other.Kind(){case reflect.Chan,reflect.Func,reflect.Interface,reflect.Map,reflect.Pointer,reflect.Slice,reflect.UnsafePointer:equal=other.IsNil();default:reply.Error="value cannot be compared with nil";return}}}else{equal=left.Equal(right);if !equal&&left.Kind()==reflect.Chan&&right.Kind()==reflect.Chan&&left.Type().Elem()==right.Type().Elem(){equal=left.Pointer()==right.Pointer()}};reply.Values=[]value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(equal))};return}
 if q.Op=="callback-proof-types" {if q.Receiver==nil{reply.Error="callback proof requires native receiver";return};v,err:=decode(*q.Receiver,nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};names,err:=callbackProofReceiverTypes(v,q.Selector);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};for _,name:=range names{reply.Values=append(reply.Values,encode(reflect.ValueOf(name)))};return}
 if q.Op=="mirrored-method-expression" {if q.Receiver==nil{reply.Error="method expression inspection requires native receiver";return};v,err:=decode(*q.Receiver,nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};reply.Values=[]value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(mirroredMethodExpression(v)))};return}
 if q.Op=="template-readonly" {if q.Receiver==nil{reply.Error="template inspection requires native receiver";return};v,err:=decode(*q.Receiver,nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};template,ok:=v.Interface().(*bppTextTemplate.Template);safe:=ok&&template!=nil&&template.Tree!=nil&&primitiveTemplateTree(template.Tree.Root);reply.Values=[]value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(safe))};return}
 if q.Op=="assignable" {if len(q.Args)!=1{reply.Error="assignability requires one value";return};typ:=resolveType(q.Selector);if typ==nil{reply.Error="unregistered bridge type "+strconv.Quote(q.Selector);return};v,err:=decode(q.Args[0],nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};result:=encode(reflect.ValueOf(v.IsValid()&&v.Type().AssignableTo(typ)));if typ.Kind()==reflect.Interface{result.Interface=q.Selector};reply.Values=[]value{result};return}
 if q.Op=="identical" {if len(q.Args)!=1{reply.Error="type identity requires one value";return};typ:=resolveType(q.Selector);if typ==nil{reply.Error="unregistered bridge type "+strconv.Quote(q.Selector);return};v,err:=decode(q.Args[0],nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};reply.Values=[]value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(v.IsValid()&&v.Type()==typ))};return}
 if q.Op=="type" {typ:=resolveType(q.Selector);if typ==nil{reply.Error="unregistered bridge type "+strconv.Quote(q.Selector);return};reply.Values=[]value{encode(reflect.ValueOf(typeID(typ)))};return}
