 if q.Op=="construct"||q.Op=="address" {if len(q.Args)!=1{reply.Error="construction requires one literal";return};typ:=resolveType(q.Selector);if typ==nil{reply.Error="unregistered bridge type "+strconv.Quote(q.Selector);return};v,err:=decode(q.Args[0],typ);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};if q.Op=="address"{ptr:=reflect.New(typ);ptr.Elem().Set(v);v=ptr};reply.Values=[]value{encode(v)};return}
 if q.Op=="var-pointer" {slot:=symbols[q.Selector];if !slot.IsValid(){reply.Error="unknown imported variable: "+q.Selector;return};if !slot.CanAddr(){reply.Error="imported symbol is not addressable: "+q.Selector;return};reply.Values=[]value{encode(slot.Addr())};return}
 if q.Op=="var-set" {if len(q.Args)!=1{reply.Error="native variable writes require one value";return};slot:=symbols[q.Selector];if !slot.IsValid()||!slot.CanSet(){reply.Error="unknown or read-only imported variable: "+q.Selector;return};v,err:=decode(q.Args[0],slot.Type());if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};slot.Set(v);return}
 if q.Op=="call"&&len(companionUnmappedFrames)>0&&collectionForcing[q.Selector] {
  if refusal:=companionSeal(q.Selector);refusal!=""{reply.Error=refusal;return}
  defer companionUnseal()
 }
 fn:=symbols[q.Selector+q.Instance]
 if q.Receiver!=nil {receiver,err:=decode(*q.Receiver,nil);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};if q.Op=="call"&&q.Selector!="Write"{revokeLocalWriter(receiver)}
  switch q.Op {case "deref","deref-set","len","cap","index","index-pointer","unsafe-slice","slice","field","field-set","field-pointer","member","method-type","receiver_field","byte-set","index-set","kind","keys":reply.Values,reply.Error=access(receiver,q);return}
  if q.Selector==""&&receiver.Kind()==reflect.Func{fn=receiver}else{fn=memberMethod(receiver,q.Selector)}}
 if q.Op=="new" {typ:=resolveType(q.Selector);if typ==nil{reply.Error="unregistered bridge type "+strconv.Quote(q.Selector);return};reply.Values=[]value{encode(reflect.New(typ).Elem())};return}
 if !fn.IsValid(){reply.Error="unknown imported symbol or method: "+q.Selector+q.Instance;return}
 if q.Op=="get" {reply.Values=[]value{encode(fn)};return}
 if q.Op!="call"||fn.Kind()!=reflect.Func{reply.Error="imported symbol is not callable";return}
 if q.FormatOnly!="" {switch q.FormatOnly {case "Sprint":fn=reflect.ValueOf(fmt.Sprint);case "Sprintln":fn=reflect.ValueOf(fmt.Sprintln);case "Sprintf":fn=reflect.ValueOf(fmt.Sprintf);default:reply.Error="invalid writer format redirection";return}}
 signature:=fn.Type();n:=signature.NumIn();minimum:=n;if signature.IsVariadic(){minimum--}
 if len(q.Args)<minimum||!signature.IsVariadic()&&len(q.Args)!=n{reply.Error="native argument count mismatch";return}
 args,scratch:=borrowCallArgs(len(q.Args))
 // Capture the original owner: originalFmtArgs below may replace args. This
 // defer runs after callback-frame removal and slice/pointer writeback.
 defer releaseCallArgs(scratch)
 for i,arg:=range q.Args {var target reflect.Type;if signature.IsVariadic()&&i>=n-1 {target=signature.In(n-1);if !q.Spread{target=target.Elem()}}else{target=signature.In(i)};v,err:=decode(arg,target);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};args[i]=v}
 for _,buffer:=range q.SliceBuffers {if buffer.Index<0||buffer.Index>=len(args)||args[buffer.Index].Kind()!=reflect.Slice{reply.Error="invalid native buffer index";return};backing,err:=decode(buffer.Value,args[buffer.Index].Type());if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};if backing.Kind()!=reflect.Slice||buffer.Length<0||buffer.Length>backing.Len(){reply.Error="invalid native buffer bounds";return};args[buffer.Index]=backing.Slice3(0,buffer.Length,backing.Len())}
 // A transferred slice (Transfers) is the interpreter handing this helper the
 // decoded slice as the storage of record: the callee may retain that exact
 // header, and the interpreter rebinds its own supplying variable to the handle
 // minted here, which shares the same backing array. No copy is written back.
 for _,i:=range q.Transfers {if i<0||i>=len(args)||args[i].Kind()!=reflect.Slice{reply.Error="invalid native transfer index";return};reply.Transferred=append(reply.Transferred,sliceBuffer{Index:i,Length:args[i].Len(),Value:encode(args[i])})}
  defer func(){for _,buffer:=range q.SliceBuffers {v:=args[buffer.Index];reply.SliceUpdates=append(reply.SliceUpdates,sliceBuffer{Index:buffer.Index,Length:v.Len(),Value:structural(v.Slice(0,v.Cap()))})};origins,ptrs:=livePointers(pointerWritebackOrigins(q));for i,origin:=range origins{elem:=structural(ptrs[i].Elem());if !writablePointee(elem.Kind){continue};snapshot:=pointerSnapshot(elem);originalPointers.Lock();changed:=snapshot!=originalPointers.sent[origin];if changed{originalPointers.sent[origin]=snapshot};originalPointers.Unlock();if !changed{continue};reply.PtrUpdates=append(reply.PtrUpdates,value{Kind:"pointer",Type:ptrs[i].Type().String(),Origin:origin,Session:bridgeAuth[:16],Elements:[]value{elem}})}}()
 if handled,err:=sourceLog(q,args);handled{reply.Error=err;return}
 var returned []reflect.Value
 if q.Receiver!=nil&&q.Selector=="" {if ctx,ok:=reflectedContext(q.Receiver.Handle);ok&&ctx.selector!="" {recv:=structural(ctx.receiver);recv.Origin=ctx.origin;recv.CallArgs=make([]value,len(args));for i,arg:=range args{recv.CallArgs[i]=encode(arg)};out,err:=callback(ctx.selector,recv);if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};if len(out)!=signature.NumOut(){reply.Error="original reflected method returned wrong result count";return};for i,item:=range out{v,err:=decode(item,signature.Out(i));if err!=nil{reply.Error=err.Error();return};returned=append(returned,v)};for _,v:=range returned{reply.Values=append(reply.Values,encode(v))};return}}
 // A call into a companion object may put a frame with no locals pointer map on
 // this goroutine. The stack is moved to its final size first, so nothing above
 // that frame asks the runtime to move it again, and collection is paced off for
 // the whole call, so nothing scans it.
 if companionGuarded(q.Selector+q.Instance) {companionEnterUnmapped();defer companionExitUnmapped();companionSink(companionGrowStack(companionStackDepth))}
 if q.Spread&&(!signature.IsVariadic()||len(args)!=n){reply.Error="invalid spread call";return}
 leaveCallbackSlices:=enterCallbackSliceFrame(q.SliceBuffers,args);defer leaveCallbackSlices()
 args=originalFmtArgs(fn,args,q.Spread)
 returned=callDependency(fn,args,q.Spread)
 for _,v:=range returned{encoded:=encode(v);if encoded.Kind=="handle" {
   var ctx reflectedMethodContext;valid:=false
   if q.Receiver==nil&&len(q.Args)==1&&q.Args[0].Origin!=0&&v.Type()==reflect.TypeFor[reflect.Value](){snapshot:=reflect.New(args[0].Type()).Elem();snapshot.Set(args[0]);ctx=reflectedMethodContext{receiver:snapshot};if args[0].Kind()==reflect.Pointer{ctx.origin=q.Args[0].Origin};valid=true
   }else if q.Receiver!=nil {if parent,ok:=reflectedContext(q.Receiver.Handle);ok {switch q.Selector {case "MethodByName":if len(args)==1&&args[0].Kind()==reflect.String{typ:=parent.receiver.Type();if typ.Kind()==reflect.Pointer{typ=typ.Elem()};parent.selector=typ.Name()+"."+args[0].String();ctx,valid=parent,true};case "Method":if len(args)==1 {i:=int(args[0].Int());typ:=parent.receiver.Type();if i>=0&&i<typ.NumMethod(){name:=typ.Method(i).Name;if typ.Kind()==reflect.Pointer{typ=typ.Elem()};parent.selector=typ.Name()+"."+name;ctx,valid=parent,true}};case "Interface":if parent.selector!=""{ctx,valid=parent,true}}}}
   if valid{if q.Receiver!=nil{encoded.Origin=q.Receiver.Origin}else{encoded.Origin=q.Args[0].Origin};setReflectedContext(encoded.Handle,ctx)}
  };reply.Values=append(reply.Values,encoded)};return
}
func nativeFaultAddr(q request)(uint64,bool){if q.Receiver==nil||len(q.Args)<1{return 0,false};switch q.Op{case "index","byte-set":default:return 0,false};n,err:=strconv.Atoi(q.Args[0].Text);if err!=nil||n<0{return 0,false};rv,err:=decode(*q.Receiver,nil);if err!=nil{return 0,false};for rv.Kind()==reflect.Interface&&!rv.IsNil(){rv=rv.Elem()};switch rv.Kind(){case reflect.Slice:if rv.Type().Elem().Kind()!=reflect.Uint8||n>=rv.Len(){return 0,false};return uint64(rv.Pointer()+uintptr(n)),true;case reflect.Array:if rv.Type().Elem().Kind()!=reflect.Uint8||n>=rv.Len()||!rv.CanAddr(){return 0,false};return uint64(rv.UnsafeAddr()+uintptr(n)),true};return 0,false}
var outputBarrierStdoutSequence uint64
var outputBarrierStderrSequence uint64
func sendAnswer(answer response){
 outbound.Lock();defer outbound.Unlock()
 if bridgeStdoutBarrier!="" {if _,err:=bppOS.Stdout.Write([]byte(bridgeAuth+"-stdout"));err==nil{outputBarrierStdoutSequence++;answer.OutputBarrierStdout=outputBarrierStdoutSequence}}
 if bridgeStderrBarrier!="" {if _,err:=bppOS.Stderr.Write([]byte(bridgeAuth+"-stderr"));err==nil{outputBarrierStderrSequence++;answer.OutputBarrierStderr=outputBarrierStderrSequence}}
 _ = outbound.encoder.Encode(answer)
}
func loadBridgeAuth(){
 if bridgeAuth!="" {return}
 data,err:=bppOS.ReadFile(bridgeAuthPath);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 bridgeAuth=string(data)
}
func main(){
 loadBridgeAuth()
 openCallbackMailbox()
 conn,err:=net.Dial(bridgeNetwork,bridgeAddress);if err!=nil{panic(err)};defer conn.Close()
 encoder:=json.NewEncoder(conn);if err=encoder.Encode(bridgeAuth);err!=nil{return};decoder:=json.NewDecoder(conn)
 outbound.Lock();outbound.encoder=encoder;outbound.Unlock()
 // Host EOF/close ends the dependency process, including blocked native calls.
 // Waiting for those calls would orphan listeners after host termination.
 for {var q request;if err:=decoder.Decode(&q);err!=nil{close(handles.stop);return};if q.Op=="close"{close(handles.stop);return}
  if q.Op=="callback-reply" {callbacks.Lock();wait:=callbacks.waiting[q.ID];callbacks.Unlock();if wait!=nil{wait<-q};continue}
  // A dependency call may end this serving goroutine with runtime.Goexit
  // (testing.T.FailNow, SkipNow). The request is still answered, as ended by
  // Goexit, so the interpreter can end the goroutine which made the call.
  go func(){answered:=false;defer func(){if answered{return};if e:=recover();e!=nil{panic(e)};sendAnswer(response{ID:q.ID,Panic:&value{Kind:"goexit"}})}();if q.Route {defer routeEnter(q.ID)()};if q.PanicOnFault {old:=bppDebug.SetPanicOnFault(true);defer bppDebug.SetPanicOnFault(old)};answer:=response{ID:q.ID};if q.PanicOnFault {defer func(){if r:=recover();r!=nil{answer=response{ID:q.ID,Error:fmt.Sprintf("native dependency panic: %v",r)};if a,ok:=r.(interface{Addr()uintptr});ok{addr:=uint64(a.Addr());answer.PanicAddr=&addr}else if addr,ok:=nativeFaultAddr(q);ok{answer.PanicAddr=&addr};answered=true;sendAnswer(answer)}}()};answer=dispatch(q);answered=true;sendAnswer(answer)}()}
}
